result.title: DConstrain: Compiling Context-Parameterized Transitions for Diffusion Language Model Constrained Decoding
result.summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) decode multiple tokens in parallel, so individually valid tokens can be incompatible together under a schema. Exact joint inference over a grammar graph enforces compatibility, but it requires token-labeled successors across many hypothetical parser configurations. Encoding stacks and field histories in compiled states can cause exponential growth, which forces prior exact decoders to fix property orders and exclude valid outputs. We present DConstrain, which compiles schemas into context-parameterized transition programs. Cold compilation specializes token consumption to local grammar states while retaining context-dependent stack operations, environment guards, and caller-dependent deferred parsing symbolically. Tracking field histories as runtime values supports arbitrary property order without enumerating field subsets offline. At runtime, warm compilation binds reached configurations to these programs to construct exact successors, overlapping with the model forward pass because graph construction requires no model scores. Furthermore, token-effect grouping merges tokens with identical compiled effects before runtime contexts are bound, so groups are reused across stacks and environments even when concrete successors differ. Objective-specific score aggregation and token restoration provably preserve both the Viterbi optimum and the token-labeled path distribution of ungrouped inference. Across three benchmarks and two DLM families, DConstrain compiles 100% of BFCL schemas under arbitrary property orders, whereas an optimized finite-state baseline compiles only 71.30-85.81%. Under arbitrary property order, it reduces BFCL end-to-end decoding latency by 6.65-46.26 times with 100% schema validity and raises DiffusionGemma's BFCL accuracy from 37.27% under fixed order to 81.56%.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 DConstrain，把 JSON 等 schema 编译为上下文参数化的转移程序，冷编译期符号化保留栈操作、环境守卫与延迟解析，运行期再绑定具体配置以构造精确联合后继，并用 token-effect 分组复用等价 token，使图构造与模型前向重叠；在 BFCL 等基准上实现 100% schema 合法并大幅降低解码延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“并行解码时精确构造联合合法后继”与编译期等价效果分组，可能可供核查用于 parallel/diffusion 式生成中同时输出多个片段或状态的一致性约束，但对象是文本结构化约束，与视觉证据和 latent 推理状态无直接联系。
